messages:
Nora: hey team, first week question — migrated dotfiles from Ubuntu to a new MacBook Air (M1, Ventura). hitting PATH and asdf shim issues. Any minimal safe steps to bootstrap without nuking my config?
Sam: welcome! :wave: quick safe flow i use:
  1) install Homebrew for arm and add /opt/homebrew to zprofile
  2) brew install asdf direnv gpg 1password-cli
  3) append asdf init to zprofile: . $(brew --prefix asdf)/libexec/asdf.sh
  4) create ~/.zshrc.local and source it from your main .zshrc so you can revert
Priya: for node plugin you might need gpg keys; run `brew install gpg` before `asdf install nodejs`. also `ssh-add --apple-use-keychain ~/.ssh/id_ed25519` for key persistence.
Nora: thanks — what about VSCode settings and machine-specific symlinks?
Sam: keep VSCode in account sync, commit only .vscode/extensions.json. for symlinks, keep them in a separate script and run piecewise so you can spot breakage.
devops-bot: Reminder: do not commit secrets or private keys. See onboarding docs for environment variable policies.
Nora: perfect. can someone pair if i hit a weird brew permission error?
Priya: I can help after lunch, ping me here.
Nora: thanks all!
